decisions.reason: Although the workstation seems less prominently committed on the website and is somewhat less central to fully automated Industry 4.0 production, it builds on the firm’s established laser-marking base so management is still likely to continue it rather than reverse course quickly.

This printer is close to the core coding business, publicly backed with its own product page, and fits the firm’s stated strategy of integrated identification solutions, which makes management likely to persist with it.

The piezo inkjet printer is also near the firm’s core offer and visibly launched as a standalone product, so in a growing firm and industry management would likely attribute any early weakness to ramp-up effects and keep it on the market.
